pattern_benchmark.label: Dashboard / status board
pattern_benchmark.verdict: Good for at-a-glance monitoring, weak for novice decision discovery.

pattern_benchmark.label: Start page / service entry
pattern_benchmark.verdict: Strong at explaining purpose and first action, but needs a decision mechanism.

pattern_benchmark.label: Task list / checklist
pattern_benchmark.verdict: Useful for multi-step completion, but this slice is one decision with optional evidence.

pattern_benchmark.label: Command center / cockpit
pattern_benchmark.verdict: Power-user friendly but repeats the current weakness: internal state can dominate.

pattern_benchmark.label: Wizard / step-by-step decision flow
pattern_benchmark.verdict: Best fit for helping a novice discover the correct next action while deferring evidence.

pattern_benchmark.label: Card board / kanban-like review surface
pattern_benchmark.verdict: Scannable but risks making all options look equal and board-like.

candidate_wireframes.label: Candidate A: start page plus decision board
candidate_wireframes.strength: Best introductory frame and low-friction first screen.
candidate_wireframes.weakness: Still asks the user to compare choices side by side.

candidate_wireframes.label: Candidate B: guided decision flow
candidate_wireframes.strength: Turns the review into a small sequence of situation checks and recommends one next action.
candidate_wireframes.weakness: Needs careful copy so it feels like guidance, not automation deciding for the user.

candidate_wireframes.label: Candidate C: novice-friendly command center
candidate_wireframes.strength: Preserves cockpit continuity and compact status visibility.
candidate_wireframes.weakness: Closest to the weak_pass prototype and most likely to keep project jargon on top.

decision: Implement a guided decision flow next; do not continue polishing the command-center cockpit pattern first.
